title: A Daily Routine
summary: A woman describes her weekday routine and contrasts it with yesterday.

paragraphs.pt: Todos os dias, Camila acorda às seis horas. Ela toma banho, prepara café e pega o ônibus para o trabalho. No escritório, responde e-mails e conversa com os clientes pelo celular.
paragraphs.en: Every day, Camila wakes up at six o'clock. She takes a shower, makes coffee, and takes the bus to work. At the office, she answers emails and talks with customers by cell phone.

paragraphs.pt: Ontem foi diferente. O ônibus atrasou, e Camila chegou vinte minutos depois. Mesmo assim, ela trabalhou bastante e terminou um relatório importante antes das cinco.
paragraphs.en: Yesterday was different. The bus was late, and Camila arrived twenty minutes later. Even so, she worked a lot and finished an important report before five.

paragraphs.pt: À noite, ela voltou para casa, colocou água na geladeira e fez uma sopa simples. Depois, leu algumas páginas de um livro e dormiu cedo.
paragraphs.en: At night, she returned home, put water in the refrigerator, and made a simple soup. Then she read a few pages of a book and slept early.

comprehension.question: How does Camila go to work?
What did she finish before five?
What did Camila do before sleeping?
